_parameters.min_observations: Per dataset: how many (before, after) step pairs an action category needs before any template is run on it.
_parameters.min_rule_observations: Per dataset: how many observations the key-pair rule value_to_key needs, counting only steps where its guard applies, before it is reported.
_parameters.min_observations_for_promotion: Per dataset: how many observations a candidate needs to be promotable. A dataset below this marks the candidate INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
_parameters.promotion_threshold: Per-dataset support (held / observations) a candidate needs in EVERY dataset to be promoted. In (0, 1].
_parameters.change_count_min_share: change_count and edit_distance templates: the most common change count / edit distance k is only proposed if it covers at least this share of the steps. In (0, 1].
_parameters.disabled_templates: Templates the engine does not mine (names as in inference/templates/). A rule already exported from such a template is still checked by the loop. Empty list [] = mine every template (the default).
_parameters.max_examples: How many hold / fail examples are kept per finding, and how many counter-examples are listed per line of the report.
_parameters.guard_min_gain: Guarded rules (inference/guards.py): a guarded rule is kept only if its support beats the same rule without the guard by at least this much in at least one dataset. In (0, 1].
_parameters.edit_distance_work_limit: edit_distance template (inference/json_edit_distance.py): how many units of work comparing one pair of snapshots may cost. A pair that needs more gives no observation instead of slowing the run. Integer >= 1.
_parameters.sweep_start: threshold_sweep.py: first promotion threshold to try.
_parameters.sweep_end: threshold_sweep.py: last promotion threshold to try (inclusive).
